I would love to help you with that. We want to find the missing numerator so that two-thirds equals something over six. 

Look at the denominators, the bottom numbers. How do we get from 3 to 6?
Is it 2/6? I just kept the top number the same because I got confused by the bottom ones changing.

That is a very common mistake! But remember, to keep the fractions equal, whatever we multiply the bottom number by, we must do the exact same to the top number. 

Since we multiplied 3 by 2 to get 6, what do we need to multiply the numerator, 2, by?

Not quite! Remember, we have to multiply the top number by the exact same thing we multiplied the bottom number by. 

We multiplied the bottom number, 3, by 2 to get 6.
